'''Security monitor droids''' were a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]]. Twenty-five of these units were employed by the [[Freeport Security Force]] at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
